coverageNotes: Mombasa county (Mombasa island, Nyali, Bamburi, Kisauni, Shanzu, Likoni, Tudor, Changamwe, Mtwapa): NO new venues were found, because no web search could be run. All six WebSearch attempts were refused with 'this turn's web search budget is used up (limit: 200 WebSearch calls per turn, shared by every agent in it)', and I did not work around that limit. The only work possible was WebFetch of the seed entries' own websites (about 20 page fetches). Results: InShape Fitness (Meru Road, behind Posta, Mombasa CBD) was confirmed with address, three phone numbers and a 2026 copyright, and is reported as new information on a seed venue. The Flex Fitness seed website was shown to be a Nairobi business, so that seed website looks wrong. Five seed websites do not resolve (The Gym, Times Health & Fitness Centre, Yogue Body & Mind, Bodyworx, Step 'n' Step), one seed domain is for sale (Legacy Fitness Club), two are down (Shotokan Academy 521, Bulldog Fitness Factory 503), one is a dead business.site page (Rash Classic Gym), and two point to unrelated organisations (Tiger Fitness Gym, The Yoga House). None of these is proof of closure and none was recorded as closed. Nothing was learned about Kisauni, Likoni, Changamwe, Mtwapa, Tudor or Shanzu beyond the seed list. Not searched at all: CrossFit boxes, women-only gyms, hotel gyms (Nyali, Bamburi, Shanzu resorts), university gyms, sports clubs, martial arts and boxing gyms, Pilates studios. These need a follow-up run once the web-search budget is available again. Hotel and club websites were not opened by guessing URLs, because that would have meant introducing venues from memory.
